Mechmania 24 & 25

Jun 07, 2018 Diana Huang Jun 07, 2018 Diana Huang

Project Description

MechMania is a 24-hour AI hackathon held annually at the Reflections Projections tech conference hosted by ACM at UIUC.

I was on the MechMania staff in 2018 & 2019. We take a year to build a game in relative secrecy. The game is unveiled at the ceremony, after which competitors have 24 hours to build a bot to best other teams.

Tech

C# & Unity for visualizer
C++ for server
C++, C#, Java, Python client for contestants

Contribution: Visualizer Team Lead

The visualizer team is responsible for receiving streams of game state data from the server and visualizing the game in Unity. I joined in MechMania 24 as a contributor and was the visualizer team lead for MechMania 25.

Contributions included:

  • Modified a JSON deserializer for our game state data
  • Developed a map generation tool to streamline the game design team's workflow
  • Implemented visualizer UI and dynamic orthographic camera movements
  • Coordinated with server team to ensure readiness by the one year deadline

While streaming on twitch, we were the top programming stream on twitch for its duration with 585 viewers!
